E0419

`#MustUse` result ignored as a bare statement (D-MUSTUSE1)

What

`#MustUse` result ignored as a bare statement (D-MUSTUSE1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0419

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0419: tests/ui/iter_unconsumed.stderr.

Error [E0419]: `Iter<Int>` must be used — it was dropped as a bare statement
  --> tests/ui/iter_unconsumed.jet:4:17
    |
  4 |     nums.lazy().map((n: Int) -> n * 2)
    |                 ^^^
 Why: a `#MustUse` result carries work or a resource that is lost when nothing checks it
 Fix: bind it (`x := …`), use `?`, `panic …`, or `.drop("reason")` to discard intentionally
